title: Dex Semantics
lede: Dex Semantics lets data teams annotate analytical models with what each row means, how tables join and how metrics add up, so coding agents produce fewer wrong numbers.

points: Declarations capture row meaning, the nature of each join, how figures roll up, and the business assumptions behind them.
They live in the model files as code, not in a separate third-party tool.
With Claude Sonnet 5.5, Dex reports 80% on ADE-bench against 73.3% without it, about a quarter fewer failed tasks.
Dex then helps the agent translate the declarations into whichever semantic layer the team already runs.
The launch comment gives the install as an agent skill: npx skills add exmergo/dex.

sections.text: Analytics engineers handing model and dashboard work to agents, where a plausible but wrong number is the costly failure.
